NC House, veto override, 2018-12-19: nay (tally 72–40); census gate: none.

Ball is listed among the additional sponsors of House Bill 1246, Safeguarding Elections Act, filed 7/30/2026. Section 2(b) adds a misdemeanor for any person to demand citizenship documentation from a voter other than what State law requires at any point during the voting process. The bill text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/HTML/H1246v1.html) also makes voter photo identification images and photocopies of identification for voting confidential records. Referred to House Rules committee 8/4/2026.
NC House, Third Reading (roll call #810), 2024-12-11: nay (tally 73–45); census gate: none.
subjects: photo ID for all voters (constitutional amendment, in person and by mail)

findings.passage: I agree 100% with the decision to strike down NC’s voter ID (etc.) law.  Voting is a fundamental, constitutionally guaranteed right that should not be restricted or discouraged, but instead should be made more accessible to everyone.
findings.note: Candidate questionnaire answer from Indy Week (2016) to a question on a federal appeals court ruling striking down the 2013 state voter ID law.
